td_city.why: Full week locked Thursday Thu Nov 5, 10:16 AM ET: 15 of 15 unstarted Hard Rock games had ATD prices. Locked: no other changes except the Sunday ~10:30 AM ET re-check (an unstarted Sun/Mon leg ruled out by ESPN or hit by the wind rule is swapped for the next-best eligible name by edge, or voided if none is left; every swap/void is logged). Candidate log saved for the re-check and audit. Rules: score = 40% RZ touches+targets/g L5, 25% goal-line share (i5/i10), 15% opponent TDs allowed to position, 10% team total (full credit at 24+, none below), 10% L10 ATD rate; each factor normalized 0-1 across the whole NFL week (Thu-Mon). Score -> calibrated anytime-TD chance; edge = that chance minus Hard Rock's no-vig chance. Legs rank by edge, then chance, then name; max 4 legs; fewer than 4 survivors of the rules/vetoes = 'Thin slate'; none = no ticket. Real Hard Rock prices -300..+600, max 1 per team, one per game (a 2nd only to reach 4), no Questionable-or-worse; Game Day Why + hard vetoes; SOFT MATCHUP: opponent rank <=20 preferred > rank n/a flagged > rank 21+ demoted (still eligible, never a veto). Locked Thursday; Sunday ~10:30 AM ET re-check swaps or voids an unstarted Sun/Mon leg ruled out (ESPN) or hit by the wind rule; otherwise a locked player who does not play settles the way Hard Rock settles it. Estimated parlay = product of single prices (Hard Rock SGP pricing may differ).

potd: No steals / blocks: see the official standards and rule 4. No POTD (or POTD backup / Today POTD) whose stat includes steals or blocks, pure or combo. [AMENDED 2026-10-31 4:46 PM ET: the steals/blocks ban applies ONLY to basketball (NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, any basketball league), pure or combo. NHL blocked shots and every non-basketball sport are ALLOWED.]
GAME DAY PROCESS applies: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤20 preferred) and the hard vetoes.
Volume potd: one POTD per sport bubble when that sport has games. Hard Rock price -105 to -135 at selection. No edge requirement (POTD and POTD #n).

Filters: the Alt Line Parlay volume filter and eligible-player rules and bans, plus hit rate at that exact line of at least 7 of last 10, with 8+ of last 10 preferred (the only hit-rate test). NASCAR (Q-NAS4,): the model must also agree (H2H: lower expected finish; Top N: expected finish <= N), a required filter on top of 7+/10; markets and hit-rate definitions in.
The card carries a "Volume" stamp. The Majors/Today POTD is the best of the Big 4 sport POTDs (NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB).
The official standards still applies: locked only from the morning prop scan, no near-miss or filler, and no POTD at all on a day LineMate data is missing or signed out.
Price drift: a POTD only has to be in band at selection. Later moves of any size never void it. Void only for inactive player or postponed/cancelled game.
A provisional pick that is out of band before lock with no in-band replacement is marked "On hold" and re-checked at lock. It still never voids for drift.

POTD auto-chain: when a sport's POTD settles, a staged pick posts as "POTD #n" (official, locked). Candidates meet the same filters, are pregame with at least 10 min to start, use no game already used by the chain, are in band, and pass a final live Hard Rock check. Nothing qualifies, nothing posts. All Sports POTD does NOT chain. The newest chain pick shows alone in the card.
Every POTD locks when posted at the 7 AM ET publish. A POTD player ruled out before his game is swapped or voided per.
parlay100: Game day process applies to every leg: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤20 preferred) and the hard vetoes.

Volume parlay: 2-3 legs. Legs may be ANY real Hard Rock line: a player prop OR a game line (spread, total, moneyline, team total), main or alt, at any price (no per-leg range) down to the -500 code floor below. No edge requirement. The eligible-prop list does not limit Parlay +100 legs.

Filters: player-prop legs pass the volume/role filter and bans and hit that exact line in 7+ of the player's last 10. Game-line legs need the team/game to have hit that line in 7+ of its last 10. 7+ of last 10 is the only hit-rate test. NASCAR (Q-NAS4,): legs also need the model to agree, a required filter on top of 7+/10.

Chain: a parlay that settles (L as soon as any leg loses) is followed by "Parlay +100 #n" built to the same rules, combined +100 to +140, using no game from an earlier parlay that day. The All Sports (Big 4) parlay chains too.
Same-game rule: legs normally come from different games. When only ONE game is on the slate or left, the ticket is built as a same-game parlay PREGAME.
All Sports parlay: safest 2-4 legs, about +100 to +115. Official. Must use different legs and cannot be a pure copy of a sport parlay.
edge: No steals / blocks: see the official standards and rule 4. The bot never builds a steals/blocks prop (pure or combo); any that slips through is dropped, NO FILL. [AMENDED 2026-10-31 4:46 PM ET: the steals/blocks ban applies ONLY to basketball (NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, any basketball league), pure or combo. NHL blocked shots and every non-basketball sport are ALLOWED.]

Hard Rock price vs Pinnacle no-vig fair. Edge % = EV% at Hard Rock price. Ranked by edge % [AMENDED 2026-11-05 8:38 AM ET, NHL EDGE FILTER below: NHL Edge ranks goal overs and SOG unders first (market priority tier), then by edge %; then at most 3 NHL assist overs per night and at most 3 NHL Edge plays per game; singles only, flat 1u]. Each pick is locked once posted.
NHL EDGE FILTER; from the Nov 5 slate; NHL Edge only):
ONE PASS, NO FILLER: Edge runs one pass and posts only plays that qualify. Nothing is filled. This supersedes COUNT's "at least 3" and ALWAYS FILL below.
Qualifying threshold: positive EV at the Hard Rock price, about -130 or better, Pinnacle prices both sides of the same line.

Grade: every Edge play shows a letter grade A..C on line 1 of its row, with the reason in its Why. Player props blend the edge % with a hit-rate model from real recent logs (last 10 + season); game lines and props with no log grade on price, max B+. Thin markets (alts, periods, 3-way) cap at B; fill plays below the bar cap at C+. Grades are display/strength only; ranking stays by edge %.

6-8% STAR: NHL Edge picks with edge >= 0.06 and < 0.08 show a gold star (⭐) and subtle gold highlight and are listed first in the NHL Edge box (rank order kept within each group); NHL picks in Big 4 / Today Edge lists get the star but are not reordered. Results is retroactive: every settled NHL Edge play with 0.06 <= edge < 0.08, dated 2026-10-25 or later and graded Win/Loss, shows the star next to its result, and the Edge results view shows a starred-plays line (W-L, units; 16-10, +19.8u at adoption). Same picks, same counting; selection and records unchanged.

Big-edge assist flag: NHL Edge assist picks (overs or unders, any assist market) with 12%+ model edge (edge >= 0.12) carry a visible warning chip and are logged to a paper-tracked split. This is a FLAG, NOT A GATE: they still post as normal Edge picks and count in Edge and the Official record exactly as before. The split is not a separate record and never changes Official totals. Baseline at adoption: 6-20, -7.15u all-time; 6-17, -4.15u since Oct 25.

BIG-EDGE 12%+ FLAG, WIDENED: every NHL Edge play with edge >= 0.12, all markets, carries 🔺 (one swappable constant BIGSYM in index.html) and a chip "🔺 12%+ edge: W-L, ±Xu since Oct 25" read live. Results show a retroactive 🔺 on settled NHL Edge 12%+ plays since 2026-10-25, with a record line under the ⭐ line. The paper-tracked tile covers all NHL 12%+ with the assist subset kept as a sub-line. One legend at the top of the NHL Edge list explains ⭐ 6-8%, 🔺 12%+ and ⚠ big-edge assist (the ⚠ assist chip stays on 12%+ assist picks; the per-row ⭐ caption is folded into it). No reorder for 🔺, no elimination, no re-pick; plays post and count as normal Edge plays and record keys are unchanged.

🟢 GREEN MARKER: an NHL Edge PLAYER play gets 🟢 when ALL three hold, each from data strictly before the pick date: (1) the opponent allowed < 3.4 goals/game over its last 5 regular-season games; (2) the opposing projected or confirmed starting goalie has save% >=.897 over his last 5 starts; (3) the player averaged < 2.5 SOG over his last 5 games (this season, plus last season if fewer than 5). Goalie unknown -> no circle (green_circle null, 'pending'), re-checked at the 10 AM / 12:30 PM / 4 PM windows and the hourly:40 goalie re-check; a confirmed-goalie result is final. the bot writes new fields only on the bot rows (green_circle, green_status, green_opp_ga_l5, green_goalie, green_goalie_status, green_goalie_sv_l5, green_sog_l5, green_why) for every NHL Edge play from 2026-11-04; normal grading settles them. Results: a live 🟢 record line from 2026-11-04 plus a separately labeled backtest line. One entry in the single NHL Edge legend.

🎯 SOG AVG AGREES: an NHL Edge Shots On Goal play gets 🎯 when the player's last-10 SOG average (games strictly before the pick date, NHL api-web game log, exact-name player match) agrees with the side: OVER -> L10 avg >= line; UNDER -> L10 avg <= line. Disagree -> no symbol. Non-SOG markets never get it. the bot logs sog_l10, sog_l10_n and sog_agree on every NHL Edge SOG row. Results: one 🎯 record line since Oct 25 with live-since-Nov 4 under it. lotto: TDC-1101 OVERHAUL. TD City only. Overrides every older line below where they conflict:

Calibrated chance and edge: the score becomes a calibrated anytime-TD chance. Hard Rock's ATD market is one-sided, so the no-vig chance per game is each implied chance times k, where k = Hard Rock's expected number of different TD scorers divided by the sum of every player's implied chance in that game, capped at 1; no ladder = the median k (0.89). EDGE = calibrated chance minus no-vig chance.

Ranking (deterministic): from the Nov 5 week the SOFT MATCHUP tier first (preferred > n/a > demoted); then edge, high to low; then calibrated chance, high to low; then the mobile-QB / goal-line-RB flag; then player name A-Z. Same inputs always give the same ticket.
Unchanged: one player / same core stat across tickets; the ticket is an L as soon as any leg loses (SETTLING below); auto-void of non-playing legs; grading.

Lock timing and why: the full ticket locks THURSDAY 10:00 AM ET. It is Thursday because the first game of the NFL week is Thursday: the Thursday lock has to cover that early slate (TNF), and it locks Sunday and Monday legs at the same time. Sunday and Monday news (inactives, weather) is handled by the Sunday re-check, not by a later lock.

Sunday re-check: for every Pending leg of a Sunday or Monday game that has not started, it pulls ESPN injuries and the Game Day weather. A leg Questionable or worse on ESPN, or hit by the wind veto / TD City wind rule, is SWAPPED for the next-best eligible name from the Thursday candidate log, re-ranked by edge at the current Hard Rock price (same band, team, game, injury and wind rules; game not started). If none is left, the leg is VOIDED and the ticket plays the remaining legs. Every swap and void is logged. ESPN unavailable = no change. This replaces FINAL LOCK's "no post-lock swaps" for injury and weather ONLY; nothing else changes after the Thursday lock. First applies to tickets locked from 2026-11-05 (flag sunday_recheck); the locked Nov 1 2026 week ticket is not changed.
Backtest: the calibrated model beats the base rate (2026 out of sample log-loss 0.508 vs 0.538) but Hard Rock's own no-vig price is better than the model. Edge is a ranking tool, not proof of value.

ALL PLAYS, NOBODY REMOVED: every straight play a Heist-eligible capper (@alexcaruso, @panpotd, @austinsprops, @showtimepicks2, @bigmikepickz) posts that day is a main HEIST leg, in capper order then posting order. A labeled POTD / top play is ADDED alongside the capper's earlier picks, never in place of one. Same-game legs stay (two cappers on one game, or two plays of one capper on one game). No leg cap. The 4 PM window and the 7 AM run rebuild from the bot keyed by (capper, play) and never drop a leg; a locked leg whose post later vanishes from the store stays. Main HEIST legs are the capper's straight line PRICED AT HARD ROCK'S LIVE PRICE for that exact line: the bot prices each straight prop leg at the Hard Rock exact-line price (hr_exact) and NCAAB at the Hard Rock exact price, and at EVERY publish hr_buydown_audit.main_refresh re-prices every not-started, unlocked main leg from the SAME live Hard Rock refresh as buy-down 1 (one fetch per market per run, shared), so a shared leg (e.g. Maluach u6.5) always shows one price on both tickets; it updates odds, hr_sid/hr_link, the whole-ticket link, recomputes the main combined price and writes the prices back to the bot. The capper's posted odds stay in orig_odds (the 'Original' combined) and on the capper record rows; record keys unchanged. No exact Hard Rock line now -> price kept as built, logged UNVERIFIED (never invented); Hard Rock feed error -> publish blocked. Started / locked / final legs are frozen. Tests: the bot. A post with no team is placed in its game by the player's team from today's ESPN rosters (roster1102, same as capper_conv.game_of). Buy-down 1 covers every one of these plays. STILL OUT (unchanged): @doctorprofit, @salbets_, @tonestakes, @habibtings, the Action Network cappers (heist.AN_CAPPERS) until the user approves, the started-game block (incl. start unknown), capper parlays / anytime TD / pick'em (unparseable), and DK-only exclusions a rule requires. OPEN QUESTIONS, OLD BEHAVIOUR KEPT until the user rules (the first one stays, the other is listed in skipped as 'open question...'): the same play posted twice by one capper; two plays on one market (same player + stat, either side or another line; or one game's spread/ML; or one game's total), e.g. opposite sides. Tests: the bot.

TALLY = INDIVIDUAL ALT PROPS: every buy-down in the Buy-downs list is its own Official 1u single, graded at its converted Hard Rock alt line (the capper's original line when no rung was kept), priced at that Hard Rock alt price (kept line: the real Hard Rock exact-line price before kickoff, else the capper's posted price). Rows are written to the bot once the game starts (conversion frozen at kickoff) and graded nightly by the bot (W pays at the price, L = -1u, push/void 0; longest rush/rec from the ESPN box-score LONG column). Not graded (not a single prop with a gradable line): capper parlays, ML/side picks and ambiguous stats; the card lists each with its reason. PROPKEY GRADER, AUTO-VOID, UNREADABLE REPORT: The bot grades the bot with the same stat reader as the Official tickets, mapped to ESPN box-score columns by propkey.box_cols (longest rush/rec on the LONG column). The bot runs automatically, zero LLM, in every capper pull path: the 7 AM pull and every the bot run (7am, 10am, 1230pm, 4pm), in this order: the bot, then a pre-audit that fixes rows (result not gating), then the bot, then the bot, then the GATE audit against the freshly built the bot, then push. It does four things.
allofficial: A former box that cannot meet the official standards is DROPPED, not converted: Runners-up, ALT LINES (sport and Big 4 cards), Home Field, NRFI and inning calls, Live POTD / Live Parlay, Live top lines, in-game lines and the NASCAR extra list. Their scripts no longer run from the bot.
Official history from before this order (POTD, Parlay +100, our recommended legs, Edge) is unchanged. No backfill, except the Lotto Ticket / TD City and Safe +100 / Alt Parlay history restored.

Strict readings: near-misses, fillers and model-only edges are not posted at all; Edge counts as Official, so Pinnacle 4% and NO FILL apply to Edge too; capper picks are idea sources tracked in Cappers only, never in the Official headline; live plays stay untracked; the NCAA F section keeps its separate record.
legday: No steals / blocks: see the official standards and rule 4. the bot qualify rejects any basketball prop whose stat includes steals or blocks (main board, backups, swaps). [AMENDED 2026-10-31 4:46 PM ET: the steals/blocks ban applies ONLY to basketball (NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, any basketball league), pure or combo. NHL blocked shots and every non-basketball sport are ALLOWED.]
What: a daily ranked Official board of up to 10 player props per sport at real Hard Rock prices -105 to -135, main or alt line. It replaces the old leg-by-leg Legs tracker.

Gates (every prop): at least 4% edge against the Pinnacle no-vig fair price. When Pinnacle has no price, the projection must be at least 8% past the line (LEG DAY only; it does not extend to any other ticket).
Game day process applies: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤22 preferred for LEG DAY) and the hard vetoes.
Source: only the morning prop scan, built on the full LineMate pull. No hand picks.
Role confirmed. Questionable players are out.
Ranking score: Edge 45, LineMate hit rate 25 (L5 weighted heaviest), matchup 15, role stability 10, news and line movement 5.
Board: numbered 1-10 by score. Stake: flat 1u per prop, shown in units only.
NFL: snap, target and rush share plus red-zone role. Healthy players post at the 7 AM ET publish; a player ruled inactive before kickoff is swapped.
NBA and WNBA: minutes and usage; usage bumps from injuries count positive; rest, back-to-backs and blowout risk count negative.
NCAAF: the NFL factors, stable depth charts only.
Holds: LEG DAY uses individual player holds only (a held prop holds alone; the board is not held as a whole).
Replacements: any replacement meets the same standard as the original pick.
Grading: nightly, each prop as a 1u single at its locked price; only final games are graded, never guessed.
